svg.title: 4 Uber rides from AI agents in Halloween week: what to plan for
svg.desc: Share card. Illustration, not a data chart: a crowd of small dots for human visits with four highlighted dots for Uber's 4 agent trips in the week that included Halloween, out of around 320 million trips. Source: Uber Q3 2026 earnings call, 4 Nov 2026.
svg.text: Megha Karnwal. Source: Uber Q3 2026 earnings call, 4 Nov 2026.
Dots are an illustration, not a data chart.
